2562  static GridTradeRule create(Decimal base_price,
2563  Decimal upper_price,
2564  Decimal lower_price,
2565  GridTrigger trigger,
2566  Decimal quantity,
2567  Decimal upper_quantity,
2568  Decimal lower_quantity,
2569  GridTimeInForce time_in_force)
2570  {
2571  GridTradeRule rule;
2572  rule.submitted_base_price = base_price;
2573  rule.upper_limit_price = upper_price;
2574  rule.lower_limit_price = lower_price;
2575  rule.trigger_quantity = quantity;
2576  rule.upper_limit_quantity = upper_quantity;
2577  rule.lower_limit_quantity = lower_quantity;
2578  rule.time_in_force = time_in_force;
2579  if (trigger.kind == GridTrigger::Kind::Percent) {
2580  rule.trigger_price_type = TriggerPriceType::Percent;
2581  rule.trigger_percent_up = trigger.up;
2582  rule.trigger_percent_down = trigger.down;
2583  } else {
2584  rule.trigger_price_type = TriggerPriceType::Spread;
2585  rule.trigger_spread_up = trigger.up;
2586  rule.trigger_spread_down = trigger.down;
2587  }
2588  return rule;
2589  }
